sockets.name: Grip
sockets.use: hand attach: on the held (front) guard 40 mm above the butt, +X along the guard, +Z out of the front (ESTIMATE, FS 5.9)

sockets.name: Pivot
sockets.use: the rivet axis (+Z): spin and aim reference

sockets.name: Tassel
sockets.use: SK_Fan_Tassel attaches here (the back eyelet); the tassel's -Z (its hang) points along the fan's -Y (down when the open fan is held upright); simulate it to hang under gravity

sockets.name: Tip
sockets.use: the leaf edge at mid-fan: trails, gusts

elements.role: the closed fan's handle / head: the one colliding shape
bounds envelope (no collision, no mass): the open fan's extent, so the mesh bounds hold the leaf at every openness

physics_bodies.role: ONE rigid body for a held prop (the game makes it Kinematic while held and simulates it when dropped); 'root' and 'pivot' coincide at the rivet, Unreal's builder puts it on 'root'
